annotation.title_clean: Enabling a national cyber-physical infrastructure (CPI) to catalyse innovation
annotation.title_en: Enabling a national cyber-physical infrastructure (CPI) to catalyse innovation
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology; Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy
annotation.summary_en: UK government GOV.UK page for the 2022 consultation and 2023 government response on a national cyber-physical infrastructure (digital twins, smart robotic systems). It sets a vision to enable innovation, with a grant competition and over £30m digital twinning funding, and reports 61 consultation responses.
key_provisions_or_claims: Consultation (Mar–May 2022) sought views on a national cyber-physical infrastructure of connected digital twins and cyber-physical systems.
Government response published 6 March 2023 identifies key enablers and next steps.
Plans a grant competition to develop and host a CPI ecosystem.
More than £30 million committed to digital twinning; transport digital twins funded.
61 responses received: 20 businesses, 17 universities, 8 public sector bodies.
